project: E2E V4 Ralph Parallel Test Sets
overview: Post-ui-rebuild E2E regression plan decomposed into four parallel Ralph testing sets with 14 total stories and explicit parity alignment.
goals: Preserve full V3 coverage while enabling four parallel testing lanes.
Keep one-story-per-iteration Ralph execution with deterministic pass/fail evidence.
Align acceptance criteria to shipped ui-rebuild behavior and intentional deltas.
Retain direct traceability to legacy 0001..0010 source slices.
nonGoals: Implementing new product features during this test loop.
Changing backend contracts, schema, or run-state semantics.
Rewriting legacy source slice PRDs under 0001..0010.
successMetrics: All 14 stories executed with explicit pass/fail evidence and negative-path validation.
Each parallel set can run independently with no cross-set story dependencies.
All known ui-rebuild divergences are reflected in acceptance criteria and execution notes.

stack.auth: Existing app route gating for dev/demo flows

routes.name: Matters List
routes.purpose: Entry point for discovery, create, and demo history surfaces

routes.name: Matter Detail
routes.purpose: Quick start, tabbed review flows, and operator checklist

routes.name: Report Triage
routes.purpose: Row filtering, drawer decisions, and citation launch

routes.name: Citation Viewer
routes.purpose: Evidence verification for citation trust and fail-closed flows

uiNotes: Runs + Alerts remains a unified disabled navigation affordance.
Create matter remains inline in the list header; upload/readiness cues are in detail setup panels.
Row drawer actions include mark-reviewed and back-to-table; no flag-issue backend mutation is assumed.
Exports uses run-state-driven control disabling rather than a global blocked banner.
Chat is matter-scoped in shipped UI; run-scope selector behavior is not a required contract.
rules: Every story execution validates at least one positive and one negative path.
Stories are test-only: no product implementation work is included in this PRD.
When a story fails, capture failing route, fixture, and error contract fields before moving on.
Maintain deterministic fixtures across reruns so parallel lanes remain comparable.

executionMode.note: Use the ralph build command as a test iteration harness only; this loop validates behavior and captures evidence, not feature implementation.
evidenceRequired: Acceptance criteria checklist with at least one example and one negative assertion
Route or surface evidence for any failure

contractAdjustments: Chat tests assert matter-scoped behavior and source-chip gating, not run-selector behavior.
Export blocking tests assert run-state disabled controls, not a required blocked-banner deep-link UI.
Drawer decision tests assert mark-reviewed and mutation-failure contracts; no flag-issue mutation is required.

stories.title: Shell Wayfinding Baseline
stories.description: As an operator, I want stable shell wayfinding so I can enter matter workflows confidently.
acceptanceCriteria: Given demo mode and at least one matter, opening /matters renders shell with Matters active.
When the operator navigates list -> detail -> list, shell context remains deterministic.
Then environment badge, breadcrumb, and stable matter identifiers are visible.
Example: breadcrumb includes Matters > Matter Name and Runs + Alerts appears disabled.
Negative: placeholder navigation never routes to broken or ambiguous screens.

stories.title: Matter Discovery Filtering
stories.description: As an operator, I want deterministic search and saved-view filters so matter discovery is reliable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given seeded matters, list search and saved-view filters are available.
When filters are applied in sequence, row sets update deterministically.
Then filter state is explicit and reversible via URL controls.
Example: saved view plus query produces a stable row subset across refresh.
Negative: empty-match states never appear without guidance or reset affordance.

stories.title: Matter Create Upload and Readiness Guidance
stories.description: As an operator, I want create and setup readiness cues so I know when a run can start.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid matter name, inline creation succeeds from the matters list header.
When documents are uploaded in detail setup, readiness transitions are explicit.
Then reasons are visible as ready, blocked, or already complete with next-step guidance.
Example: missing required documents yields blocked state with concrete guidance text.
Negative: empty-name creation is rejected with validation and no new matter created.

stories.title: Quick Start Readiness Gate
stories.description: As an operator, I want Quick Start to enforce readiness so blocked matters cannot start runs.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a blocked matter, Quick Start is visibly blocked with an explicit reason.
When readiness transitions to runnable, Quick Start starts a run without reload hacks.
Then run progress becomes visible immediately in detail context.
Example: blocked-to-ready fixture change enables start and creates a run.
Negative: blocked start attempts return explicit conflict behavior and no run creation.

stories.title: Run Triage Tab Scope Contract
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want triage tabs to filter deterministically within current run scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a run with mixed statuses, All, Needs Review, Reviewed, and Flagged tabs are visible.
When each row tab is selected, rows filter by status while retaining run scope.
Then URL and visible counts remain consistent with selected tab.
Example: Needs Review count equals visible rows after tab switch and refresh.
Negative: tab changes never leak rows from another run.

stories.title: Drawer Decisions and Mutation Feedback
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want drawer-first decisions and explicit mutation feedback for reliable triage.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a needs_review row, opening the row launches a drawer with deterministic payload.
When mark reviewed is triggered, row and drawer states update without full-page refresh.
Then copy actions return explicit success or failure feedback.
Example: reopening a marked row shows reviewed state persisted.
Negative: mutation failure renders ErrorBanner and leaves review status unchanged.

stories.title: Valid Citation Trust Viewer Verification
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want valid citations to open verifiable evidence with trust metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid citation, source chips open the viewer at expected document and page.
When the viewer loads, highlight overlays and trust metadata render from payload.
Then reset-to-100 restores explicit verification posture.
Example: valid citation displays one or more polygons and no failure panel.
Negative: missing trust metadata payload renders deterministic fallback, not a silent success state.

stories.title: Invalid Citation Fail Closed
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want invalid citations to fail closed with explicit recovery cues.
acceptanceCriteria: Given corrupted or unresolved citations, source-chip gating is explicit.
When an invalid citation is opened, viewer renders citation_failed reason code.
Then highlight overlays are absent.
Example: unresolved anchor source chip is disabled with explanation text.
Negative: invalid citations never render stale or approximate highlight polygons.

stories.title: Safe Run Scoped Exports
stories.description: As an operator, I want exports to run only for eligible completed runs.
acceptanceCriteria: Given run selector context, completed safe runs are export-eligible.
When an eligible run is selected, CSV and DOCX exports produce downloadable artefacts.
Then artefact metadata remains bound to selected run_id.
Example: selecting a safe completed run enables export and downloads both formats.
Negative: incomplete runs do not produce downloadable artefacts.

stories.title: Export Blocking State Contract
stories.description: As an operator, I want blocked or incomplete run states to prevent unsafe exports explicitly.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a run in blocked, failed, or incomplete state, export actions remain disabled.
When operator switches to a completed safe run, export controls become enabled.
Then control-state behavior is deterministic across route refresh and run selector changes.
Example: completed run enables download controls while blocked run keeps controls disabled.
Negative: blocked or incomplete runs never produce files or stale signed links.

stories.title: Artefact Provenance Retrieval and Download Safety
stories.description: As an operator, I want provenance-rich artefact retrieval with deterministic filtering and error visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Given mixed artefacts, list renders source_run_id and provenance metadata.
When kind, type, and safety filters are applied, row sets update deterministically.
Then each row exposes actionable download controls with explicit loading or error states.
Example: unsafe filter shows only UNSAFE-labelled rows with explanation context.
Negative: expired signed URLs surface explicit errors and never fail silently.

stories.title: Matter Scoped Chat Contract
stories.description: As an operator, I want deterministic matter-scoped chat behavior with transparent source-jump gating.
acceptanceCriteria: Given indexed matter context, chat composer is available without requiring a run selector.
When a question is submitted, sending, streaming, and final response states are explicit.
Then source chips are clickable only for anchor-ready citations.
Example: anchor-ready chip opens viewer at expected document and page.
Negative: no indexed context disables composer with guidance and no request is sent.

stories.title: Demo Operator Pack Load Reload Loop
stories.description: As a demo operator, I want allowlisted pack load and reload behavior to remain predictable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given demo mode is enabled, toolbar displays explicit DEMO MODE posture and allowlisted packs.
When a pack loads, system creates or opens deterministic demo matter context.
Then checklist progression and timing metadata are visible or explicitly unavailable.
Example: load pack again creates a new demo matter without deleting prior records.
Negative: non-allowlisted pack values fail validation and create no matter.

stories.title: Cross Surface Error Retry and Support Contract
stories.description: As an operator, I want consistent error contracts and safe recovery cues across surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Given failures in at least three surfaces, each renders deterministic ErrorBanner structure.
When a failure is retryable and a handler exists, Retry action replays idempotently.
Then support affordance includes only safe context fields: code, trace_id, and route.
Example: non-retryable validation errors hide Retry while still exposing support path.
Negative: missing support configuration yields fallback guidance with copyable identifiers.
